description: A Framework for Synthetic Power System Dynamics / Code Companion is a software deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Anna Büttner (Potsdam-Institute for Climate Impact Research). This repository contains the source code, scripts, and data used in the "A Framework for Synthetic Power System Dynamics" Paper. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
